sources.title: UniFi Access Point | Releases | Ubiquiti Community

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is only for these models:

U6-LR/U6-Lite/U6+
UAP-nanoHD/FlexHD/BeaconHD/IW-HD

Improvements

Improved client connectivity and roam event reporting.
Improved Auto-Link compatibility.
Improved stability.

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue where Auto Channel Selection on 2.4 GHz could select restricted channels.
Fixed connectivity issues where UDB-IoT clients could not access the internet.
Fixed an issue where UDB-IoT clients could not reach certain clients connected to UniFi APs.
Fixed an issue where channel width was not synchronized on meshed APs.
Fixed an issue causing clients to get stuck in a roaming loop between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
Fixed an issue where clients could not connect using OWE.
Fixed an issue where clients were repeatedly rejected by the AP.
Fixed an issue where AP configuration would not be saved properly.
Fixed an issue where the AP would fail to broadcast beacons.

Additional information
Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Release Candidate.

If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.

----
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
articles.title: UniFi Access Point for U6-LR, U6-Lite, U6+ & more 6.7.54

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:


U7-Pro-Max, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-In-Wall, U7-Lite, U7-Mesh - May 29, 2026
U7-Pro - June 4, 2026
U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Outdoor, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - June 10, 2026

Bugfixes

Fixed WiFi dropping when Wireless Meshing is disabled and the gateway is unreachable.

Additional information
INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.
----
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
UniFi Console Support File (as private attachment)
